Your Privacy

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences, or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
Cookie Policy
Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Functional Cookies

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Targeting Cookies

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Performance Cookies

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Taker fees paid on USDT-quoted pairs are returned as a USDT distribution;

USDC distribution = Taker fees actually paid (USDC-quoted pairs) * discount rate

What is Futures Earn?

Futures Earn is a financial product offered by MEXC for Futures users. Once activated, eligible funds in your Futures account will automatically enroll in this exclusive investment product, generating daily interest without affecting your regular Futures trading, helping you efficiently grow your account value.
Will activating Futures Earn affect my Futures trading?
No. Futures Earn calculates interest based on your Futures account equity. Once enabled, you can continue to open and close positions, and place orders exactly as you did before.
How is interest calculated and distributed?
Interest is calculated hourly and distributed to your Spot account the next day, then automatically transferred to your Futures account. You can view your total interest anytime.

Qualifying Balance of each day = Lowest USD1 balance captured during those hourly snapshots on each day.
Weekly Rewards = (7-day average of the Qualifying Balance * Effective APR on the distribution day * 7) / 365

After each weekly distribution, the effective APR for that period will be updated in this announcement. In determining the effective APR on the distribution day, Binance will take into account a number of factors, including, without limitation:
Minimum recorded amount of Open Interest per day;
Lowest balance of the snapshots each day;
The daily aggregated amount of Qualifying Balances across all eligible holders of USD1;
7-day average across all eligible holders of USD1

USD1 Balance before Leverage = MAX [USD1 Balance in Margin Account - Margin Account Liabilities of the Other Stablecoins, 0]
Leveraged Amount = USD1 Balance in Margin Account - MAX [USD1 Balance in Margin Account - Margin Account Liabilities of the Other Stablecoins, 0]
Note: ”Other Stablecoins” include USDT, USDC, U, RLUSD, FDUSD.

blocks.x: TL;DR
Kraken was named Fintech Company of the Year – Established at the Business Post’s National Fintech Awards 2026 in Dublin.
The Fintech Company of the Year award recognizes innovation, progress, and market influence, judged on product advances, measurable results, and impact on the wider Irish fintech industry.
We were shortlisted alongside some of the biggest names in Irish fintech.
Ireland remains central to how we serve clients across the EEA.
On October 15, Kraken was named Fintech Company of the Year – Established at the fourth annual National Fintech Awards, held at the Round Room at the Mansion House in Dublin.
We were up against a strong shortlist of established fintech companies, and we’re proud to bring the award home for the work we’ve put into building and scaling in Ireland.
What the National Fintech Awards recognize

Organized by the Business Post in association with GRID Finance, the National Fintech Awards celebrate achievement across the Irish fintech industry, from early-stage start-ups to the most established names. The 2026 awards spanned 17 categories, each judged against its own criteria.

The Fintech Company of the Year awards look for companies that show real innovation, progress, and market influence. Entrants set out their mission and market focus, the products and strategic advances they delivered over the past year, and the measurable results behind them, including growth, users, revenue, and impact. Winners have to show strong momentum, clear value for customers, and a visible effect on the wider industry.
Why Ireland

Ireland is a core part of how we serve clients across Europe. Our Irish entities are regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland and provide crypto brokerage and MiCA custody to clients in the EEA, and operate our MiCA-authorized trading platform. Payward also holds an EMI license from the Central Bank of Ireland, which sits alongside our other regulated infrastructure as part of Payward Banking.

We didn’t build here to tick a box. We built here because Ireland offers the talent, the regulatory clarity, and the fintech ecosystem you need to build a global financial services company that clients can trust.
Building on a regulated foundation

We think about growth in Ireland the same way we think about growth everywhere: one license, one market, one layer of infrastructure at a time. A clear regulatory framework lets us build the products clients actually use and stand behind them with confidence. Those products need to be secure, transparent, and ready to scale.

That approach is also why Europe features so prominently in our wider roadmap. Earlier this month, Payward signed a definitive agreement to acquire Saldo Bank, a digital-first, EU-licensed bank, as the next step in building out the EU layer of Payward Banking.
Built for clients across Europe

The foundation we’ve built in Ireland supports the products we bring to clients across the EEA. This week, we made Unified Wallet available to EEA clients on Kraken Pro, so clients can use their existing spot, margin, and earn balances as futures collateral without moving funds between wallets. We’ve also brought US-listed stocks to European clients, bridging traditional markets and crypto in one place.
The goal is the same every time: give clients one place to hold, trade, and put their assets to work, backed by the regulatory standards they should expect from a financial institution.
What’s next

We’re proud of this recognition, but we’re even more motivated by what’s ahead. We’ll keep investing in Ireland, keep expanding what we offer to clients across Europe, and keep building the regulated infrastructure that makes it possible. This award is a great milestone, and we’re just getting started.

blocks.x: Rising Trader Boost Multiplier

For the purpose of this Promotion, “Rising Traders” refers to users who, as of three days before the start of the Promotion Period, have won any rewards in fewer than 3 previous Binance Wallet’s Alpha trading competitions.
Eligible Rising Traders will receive a 1.2x Rising Trader Boost on their actual trading volume during the Promotion Period, subject to a Rising Trader Boost Cap.
Notes:
The "Rising Trader" qualification is determined as of three days before the activity period begins.

For example, if a user wins a trading competition ending on Day T, and their cumulative historical win count reaches exactly 3 at that point, they will still qualify as a Rising Trader for new competitions starting on T+1 and T+2 (since the qualification snapshot was taken before their 3rd win). However, for competitions starting on T+3 and beyond, their historical win count will already be 3 or more at the qualification snapshot, and they will no longer be eligible for the Rising Trader bonus.

The Rising Trader Boost Cap refers to the maximum actual trading volume that can receive the Rising Trader Boost during the Promotion Period. Once a user’s Rising Trader Boost Cap has been reached, the user will no longer receive Rising Trader Boosts for any subsequent trading volume.
If both the Early Bird Boost Multiplier and Rising Trader Boost apply, Effective Trading Volume will be calculated as follows:
Effective Trading Volume = Actual Trading Volume * Early Bird Boost Multiplier + min(Actual Trading Volume, Remaining Rising Trader Boost Cap) * Rising Trader Boost

The final ranking will be calculated based on users’ total Effective Trading Volume during the Promotion Period. A user’s total Effective Trading Volume is the sum of their daily Effective Trading Volume during the Promotion Period.
Example:

User A generates 10,000 USDT in actual trading volume on Day 1. The Day 1 Early Bird Boost Multiplier is 3.0x, and User A is also eligible for the 1.2x Rising Trader Boost. The Rising Trader Boost Cap is 5,000 USDT.
User A's Day 1 Effective Trading Volume is calculated as follows:
Early Bird Boost: 10,000 * 3.0 = 30,000 USDT

Rising Trader Boost: User A's actual trading volume (10,000 USDT) exceeds the Rising Trader Boost Cap (5,000 USDT), so only 5,000 USDT is eligible for the Rising Trader Boost = 5,000 * 1.2 = 6,000 USDT
Day 1 Effective Trading Volume = 30,000 + 6,000 = 36,000 USDT

After Day 1, User A's 5,000 USDT Rising Trader Boost Cap has been fully used. Therefore, User A will no longer receive the Rising Trader Boost for any subsequent trading volume during the Promotion Period.
Please Note:
Only trades executed via Binance Wallet (Keyless) or Binance Alpha on Binance Wallet will qualify in this Promotion. Third-party dApp transactions are excluded.
Only cumulative purchases count as trading volume for the purposes of the Promotion. Selling is excluded.
No Volume Caps : There is no cap on the trading volume for each participant in this Promotion.
Token bridging transactions are not eligible for this Promotion.

Binance is excited to launch the USDC Holding APR Promotion! During the Promotion Period, all eligible users will enjoy a 2% APR reward on their eligible Net USDC Holding in Binance Futures and Portfolio Margin accounts.
Promotion Mechanism
1. Eligible Users

To earn rewards for a weekly period, users must generate at least $2,500 in USDC-margined trading volume (USDC-M Futures pairs) within that weekly period. The Promotion Period consists of four weekly periods:
Weekly Period · Time Frame (UTC)
2. Eligible Asset
USDC balances as defined under "Net USDC Holding" below: Futures account USDC balance for all users, plus Margin account USDC balance for Portfolio Margin users.
3. Eligible Balance

Net USDC Holding: The maximum eligible balance is $1,000,000 Net USDC Holding per user, applied at the master account level. Net USDC Holding across all sub-accounts will be aggregated under the master account. Any amount above $1,000,000 will not earn rewards.
Net USDC Holding is calculated as:
Portfolio Margin users: Portfolio Margin account USDC balance − Portfolio Margin account USDC liability
Non-Portfolio Margin users: Futures account USDC balance − Margin account USDC liability
Notes:
Portfolio Margin: A unified margin mode that lets users share collateral across UM + CM + Margin accounts.
For more information, refer to this Portfolio Margin FAQ.
Margin account USDC liability refers to the total outstanding borrowed USDC in the Margin account.
Negative Net USDC Holding are not eligible to receive rewards.
4. Rewards Calculation & Distribution
Daily reward = min(daily average Net USDC Holding, $1,000,000) × 2% ÷ 365
Net USDC Holding is measured via snapshots taken at random times between 00:00:00 and 23:59:59 (UTC) each day

Rewards accrue daily and are settled weekly: Users who meet the weekly trading volume threshold will receive all rewards accrued during that weekly period. For these purposes, the daily average Net USDC Holding is the average of the Net USDC Holding recorded across that day’s snapshots.
Rewards will be distributed in USDC to the eligible user’s Spot account (master account) within 5 calendar days (excluding weekends and UAE public holidays) after each weekly period ends.

Example: User A maintains a daily average Net USDC Holding of $1,500,000 during Week 1 and generates $3,000 in USDC-margined trading volume in Week 1. User A will receive ($1,000,000 × 2% ÷ 365) × 7 ≈ $383.56 in USDC for Week 1.
Terms & Conditions
This Activity is a rewards program based on qualifying trading activity and eligible Net USDC Holding; it is not a game of chance or skill.
Only users who complete identity verification can qualify for rewards in the Promotion, and only master accounts will receive rewards. Broker accounts are not eligible to participate.

Trade the hottest bStocks across $SPCXB, $SKHYB, $MSTRB, $CRCLB, and $NVDAB on Aster and compete for a share of the prize pool, with higher tiers unlocked as total trading volume grows. Plus, enable Multi-Assets Mode and use eligible bStocks as collateral for perpetual trading to qualify for a share of an additional $20,000 $ASTER prize pool. Trade more, unlock more rewards!
Campaign Overview
Eligible trading pairs: SPCXB/USDT, SKHYB/USDT, MSTRB/USDT, CRCLB/USDT, and NVDAB/USDT
Campaign period: Oct 20, 10:00 UTC — Oct 31, 23:59 UTC
Reward distribution: by Nov 7, 23:59 UTC (within 7 working days after the campaign ends.)
Prize pool: Up to $50,000 in $NVDAB + $20,000 in $ASTER
Rules
Users must click the registration button on the campaign landing page to join. Only spot trading volume from the eligible pairs generated after registration will count toward the competition.
The campaign features a prize pool of up to $70,000 in total rewards, and the reward structure is as follows:
1️⃣ Volume Leaderboard: Up to $50,000 in $NVDAB
2️⃣ bStocks Collateral Participation Pool: $20,000 in $ASTER
1. Volume Leaderboard: Up to $50,000 in $NVDAB

Each participant’s reward will be allocated proportionally according to their share of the total eligible trading volume. Estimated rewards will be displayed on the campaign landing page throughout the campaign. Only reward amounts equal to or greater than 0.001 $NVDAB will be distributed.

The final prize pool will be determined based on the total valid trading volume generated by all participants (excluding MM volume) during the campaign period. Higher tiers will be unlocked once the following milestones are reached:
1️⃣ Total valid volume ≤ 50M: $10,000 in $NVDAB
2️⃣ 50M < Total valid volume ≤ 100M: $30,000 in $NVDAB
3️⃣ Total valid volume > 100M: $50,000 in $NVDAB
2. bStocks Collateral Participation Pool: $20,000 in $ASTER
Users can qualify for an additional share of the participation pool by using eligible bStocks as collateral for perpetual trading on Aster, with each participant receiving up to $50 in $ASTER.
To qualify, participants must:
1️⃣ Register for the campaign.
2️⃣ Enable Multi-Assets Mode and use eligible bStocks as collateral in their Aster Perpetuals account.
3️⃣ Generate at least $5,000 in perpetual trading volume during the campaign period.
4️⃣ Maintain at least $500 worth of eligible bStocks as collateral in their Aster Perpetuals account during the campaign period.
Rewards are distributed proportionally based on each participant’s time-weighted holding balance during the campaign.
Individual Reward = (Individual Score ÷ Total Score of All Eligible Participants) × $20,000 in $ASTER
Score = Σ ($bStocks Balance × Holding Time (hours))
Only balance held for at least 1 full hour will be counted toward the reward calculation. For example, a position held for 2.5 hours will be counted as 2 hours for the score calculation.

FAQ
What is IPO Prime?

IPO Prime is a global asset subscription platform launched by Bitget, focusing on investment opportunities in the pre-listing and initial public offering stages of companies. Eligible users can participate using supported stablecoins without opening a separate overseas brokerage account. The platform includes two sections: Pre-IPO and IPO:

Pre-IPO: Participate before the company goes public. Pre-tokens are delivered. Holding pre-tokens represents a debt instrument from the issuer to the holder, designed to reflect the company's performance;
IPO: Participate during the company's official IPO issuance stage. Settlement is based on the official issue price, and allocated assets are delivered as rTokens backed by real stocks.
What is the difference between IPO subscription on Bitget IPO Prime and traditional brokerage subscription?

The Lighter Points Program on the Robinhood Chain is a way to recognize eligible users for participating in the trading platform and reward them for the value they bring.

Points are calculated and awarded in real time based on eligible activity, with an additional weekly points drop every Friday (first weekly drop on Fri Aug 21). The way points are calculated may change over time as we continue improving the program and rewarding meaningful participation while keeping things fair for everyone.
Live & Weekly Points
The live points are distributed in real time based on factors like volume, positions held, fees paid, using assets other than USDG as collateral, and others. Most markets have the same weight.
Weekly points are based on the activity from the previous Friday (incl.) to Thursday (incl.), are distributed every Friday, and are fine-tuned depending on the week’s activity.
For both point types, standard-to-standard activity is not rewarded.
Boosts
There are several ways for a user to boost their points. Some apply to both live and weekly points; others apply only to weekly points.
Robinhood Wallet Mobile boost

The mobile boost is linear and ranges from 1x for a user with only non-RH wallet mobile app volume to 2x for a user with only RH wallet volume. The volume is considered coming from the plaftorm that the order was placed from.
The boost influences both live and weekly points.
Referral boost
If you refer a trader, you get 10% of their points (live + weekly).
Referred traders get a 10% boost for their weekly points.
Market boosts
Some markets generate more points than others. Some do so for live points, some for the weekly, some for both.

A notable current boost is the earnings boost for weekly points: if an RWA market is tied to a company that does its earnings call in the interval the weekly points are calculated for, that market is boosted.
Pre IPO markets and new listings may also get boosts.
Hedge boost
The hedge boost allows traders to hedge (some of) their Lighter RH positions on Lighter Core and get more points for it.
For each market present on both venues, the 2.5x boost only applies to one pair of directions (e.g. long Core, short RH) out of the two.

A partial hedge also counts: if your position on Lighter RH is $100, but you're only hedged for $50 on Lighter Core, you will get a 1.75x boost. Otherwise, if the (opposing) position on Core is the same or larger, you get the complete boost.
The hedge boost only applies to weekly points and can be updated weekly. We consider the following categories for the boost, with directions specified below.

These Terms govern eligibility for the Lighter on the Robinhood Chain Points Program (the "Program"). By participating in the Program, you agree to these Terms.

The purpose of the Program is to reward genuine participation on Lighter on the Robinhood Chain. Points are intended to recognize authentic trading activity and meaningful participation in the ecosystem—not activity designed to manipulate or exploit the Program.
1. General Eligibility
Lighter on the Robinhood Chain determines, in its sole discretion, whether activity is eligible to earn points.
2. Ineligible Activity
The following activities are not eligible to receive points and may result in point adjustments, disqualification, or removal from the Program.
A. Market Manipulation
This includes, but is not limited to:
Wash trading.
Self-trading or trading between commonly controlled accounts.
Artificially inflating trading volume or liquidity.
Coordinated trading intended to manipulate markets or Program metrics.
Spoofing, layering, quote stuffing, or other deceptive trading practices.
Any activity intended to create artificial or misleading market activity.
B. Sybil Activity
Operating or controlling multiple accounts to earn additional points.
Splitting activity across multiple accounts to increase rewards.
Creating, purchasing, renting, borrowing, or otherwise controlling accounts for the purpose of farming points.
Any attempt to disguise common ownership or coordinated control of accounts.
C. Referral Abuse
Self-referrals.
Circular or reciprocal referral schemes.
Creating accounts solely to generate referral rewards.
Artificially inflating referral activity or referral-based rewards.
D. Automated or Artificial Participation
Activity primarily intended to farm points rather than participate in markets.
Using bots, scripts, or automated systems to manipulate Program metrics.
Coordinated behavior designed to exploit the Program or its scoring methodology.
E. Abuse of Program Mechanics
Exploiting bugs, vulnerabilities, or unintended behavior.
Circumventing Program rules or safeguards.
Manipulating snapshots, scoring methodologies, or eligibility calculations.
Any activity intended to obtain points in a manner inconsistent with the purpose of the Program.
F. Fraudulent or Unlawful Conduct
Fraud, deception, impersonation, or identity abuse.
Providing false, misleading, or inaccurate information.
Using stolen, compromised, or unauthorized accounts.
Activity that violates applicable law or the Terms of Service of Lighter on the Robinhood Chain.
3. Ongoing Integrity Reviews
To protect the integrity of the Program, **Lighter ** continuously performs automated and manual reviews, including Sybil detection, fraud detection, behavioral analysis, and other integrity checks.
These reviews may occur at any time during the Program or after it has concluded.
The fact that points have been awarded or remain visible in an account does not mean they have been permanently approved or are no longer subject to review.
4. Point Adjustments and Enforcement
If Lighter determines that an account has engaged in fraudulent, abusive, manipulative, or otherwise ineligible activity, Lighter may, at any time and in its sole discretion:
Remove or reduce points.
Reverse previously awarded points.
Disqualify specific transactions or activity from earning points.
Suspend or permanently remove an account from the Program.
Exclude an account from future rewards, distributions, or Program benefits.

These actions may be taken before, during, or after points have been awarded, including after the conclusion of the Program if subsequent reviews identify activity that is determined to be fraudulent, abusive, manipulative, or otherwise ineligible.
5. Final Determination
Lighter on the Robinhood Chain reserves the right to interpret these Terms and determine Program eligibility in its sole discretion.

The examples listed in these Terms are illustrative and not exhaustive. Any activity that Lighter on the Robinhood Chain reasonably believes undermines the fairness, integrity, or intended purpose of the Program may be deemed ineligible, even if not specifically described above.
Participation in the Program constitutes acceptance of these Terms and any updates or modifications published by Lighter on the Robinhood Chain.

blocks.x: Event Rules
Eligibility
A new user is defined as a user who registers during the event period, or whose total deposit amount (including on-chain, fiat, and P2P deposits) was less than $100 prior to the event start date.
Participants must click the "Register Now" button on the event page to be eligible for the event.

Each user may only participate in one Airdrop+ event at a time. If a user has registered for Event A, they must wait until that event has ended before joining another Airdrop+ event. Event periods must not overlap.
Market makers, institutional users, and certain affiliates and their referees are not eligible to participate in this event or claim any related rewards.

The system will automatically calculate each participant's total deposit amount and trading volume. For users who register before the event begins, the tracking period will be from the event start date to the end date. For users who register after the event has started, the tracking period will be from the time of registration to the end of the event. Deposits and trades made before registration will not be included in the event statistics, but will not affect eligibility or reward distribution.
New User Task
Participants must complete Advanced KYC Verification to be eligible for rewards.

There are no restrictions on deposit crypto. Users may deposit any token, which will be converted into USDT value based on the platform's prevailing price at the time of deposit for reward calculation purposes. All deposits for this event are calculated as net deposits, using the formula: Net Deposit Amount = Total Deposits – Total Withdrawals. Deposit amounts are calculated based on the token value at the time of deposit, while withdrawal amounts are based on the token value at the time of withdrawal. Participants whose net deposit amount is below the minimum requirement at the end of the event will not be eligible for rewards.

Eligible deposit methods include P2P, fiat deposits, and on-chain transfers. Eligible withdrawal methods include on-chain withdrawals, internal transfers, P2P or fiat withdrawals, and gift withdrawals.

Spot trading volume includes transactions in USDT, USDC, USDE, and USD1 trading pairs, as well as Convert transactions. Valid Futures trading volume includes the participant's total trading volume (open positions + close positions) in USDT-M, USDC-M, and USDE-M perpetual Futures, as well as copy trading and grid trading volume. Only trading volume that incurs non-zero fees during the event period will be counted. Trading volume that uses fee vouchers will not be included.
Spot Trading Challenge
Participants must complete at least Primary KYC Verification before the event ends to qualify for rewards.
Spot trading volume calculations include trades made in USDT, USDC, USDE, USD1, and Convert trades.
Trading volume calculation rules may vary across different events. For specific details, please refer to the rules on the respective event page.
Tokens labeled with "0 Fees" are eligible for zero Spot trading fees during the Airdrop+ event. The exact duration of the fee waiver is subject to the details displayed on the trading page.
Completion status for the Spot Trading Challenge will not be displayed on the event page. Trading volume is automatically recorded and verified by the system.
Futures Trading Challenge
Participants must complete at least Primary KYC Verification before the end of the event to be eligible for rewards.

Only users who meet the minimum Futures trading volume requirement will qualify for the corresponding reward tier. Users who do not meet the minimum threshold will not be ranked or eligible for any rewards.

After the event ends, the system will automatically rank participants based on their valid Futures trading volume. In the case of identical trading volumes, rankings will be determined by the time the trading volume was first reached.

Rewards for the lowest tier will be distributed based on each user's proportion of valid Futures trading volume relative to the total volume within that tier. A maximum reward cap applies to each user. Please refer to the event details for specific limits.

Valid Futures trading volume includes the participant's total trading volume (open positions + close positions) in USDT-M, USDC-M, and USDE-M Perpetual Futures, as well as copy trading and grid trading volume (excluding stablecoin Futures such as USDCUSDT). Only trading volume that incurs non-zero fees during the event period will be counted. Trading volume that uses fee vouchers will not be included.
The completion status of the Futures Trading Challenge will not be displayed on the event page. All trading volumes are automatically recorded and verified by the system.
Referral Rewards

Referees must complete their sign-up during the event period for the referral to be deemed valid. Referrals involving referees who signed up before the event started will not be counted toward the event's referral statistics, and the referrer will not be eligible to receive the corresponding reward.
Referred users must complete the New User Tasks, which includes making a net deposit of $100 in any token and trade Spot or Futures to qualify for the reward.
Referrers participating in this event do not have to register.
General

Convert volume are also counted towards eligible Spot tasks, with volume calculated as the USDT equivalent of the source token (the "from" token) based on the most recent 1-hour closing price of the source token/USDT pair. Only conversions to and from the event token qualify.

Token rewards denoted in USDT equivalent (e.g., $50,000 in token X) are calculated based on the token's average daily price in USDT during the event. Daily Average Price = Daily Traded Volume (in USDT) / Daily Traded Quantity. The average price for the event period represents the mean of all daily average prices, with each day defined as the 24-hour period from 16:00 (UTC) to 16:00 (UTC) on the following day.

Rewards will be issued within 10 calendar days after the event ends. All rewards are issued on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last. Token rewards will be airdropped to users' Spot accounts. Futures bonuses (valid for 14 days) will be issued to Futures accounts and can be used as margin. Profits made with bonuses are withdrawable.
This event does not constitute investment advice. Participation in this event is entirely voluntary.

All participating users must strictly abide by the MEXC Terms of Service. MEXC reserves the right to disqualify any participants who engage in dishonest or abusive activities during the event, including bulk-account registrations to farm additional bonuses and any other activities in connection with unlawful, fraudulent or harmful purposes.
MEXC reserves the right to modify the terms of this event without prior notice.
MEXC reserves the right of final interpretation for this event. If you have any questions, please contact the Customer Service team.

Qualifying Balance of each day = Lowest RLUSD balance captured during those hourly snapshots on each day.

Each participant may use only one Binance Wallet linked account for the Campaign and may join only one team. If the same account participates through multiple MPC wallets, all participation records and points will be consolidated under that account and will not be treated as separate participants.
Competition Rules

Eligible markets: Match-winner markets associated with League of Legends World Championship matches during the Campaign Period will count. The eligible market scope, match order, and settlement status shown on the Campaign Page will apply.

Eligible channels: Trades must be completed through the Prediction entry point on the Binance App integrated interface or the designated Predict.fun entry point in Binance Wallet. Trades completed through other channels will not count.

Minimum participation amount: For each match, a participant must use their own funds to open positions with an aggregate value of at least 10 USDT in the outcome used for Campaign scoring before the match begins.

Holding requirement: The full eligible position used for Campaign scoring must be held until the corresponding market settles. Positions opened after the match begins, or scoring positions sold in whole or in part before settlement, earn no Match Points and do not satisfy member activation.

Multiple outcomes in the same match: A participant may hold two or more outcomes for the same match. However, only the team or outcome associated with the participant’s first buy order for that match will be treated as the valid prediction for Campaign scoring and member activation. Positions in other outcomes do not create additional scoring records or points.

Eligible funds: Trading vouchers, Trial Funds, bonuses, and other non-self-funded amounts do not count toward the minimum participation amount. If a trade combines the participant’s own funds with subsidized funds, only the self-funded portion will count.
Score precision: Individual and team scores are recorded to two decimal places. Digits after the second decimal place are truncated without rounding.

Member activation: After joining a team, a user must use eligible funds to open at least one eligible position worth at least 10 USDT before kickoff and hold the position used for Campaign scoring until settlement. Once that trade is confirmed as valid, member status and the applicable team bonus take effect from that match onward. Match Points earned before activation are not credited to the team or recalculated retroactively. Favorite-team points already earned are credited once the member becomes eligible. Team members who joined before the team-formation deadline may still activate afterward.

No team changes: Once a user joins a team, the user cannot leave or switch teams, and the team captain cannot remove the user. Users should confirm the team details and available slots before joining.

blocks.x: Campaign Details

Register during the campaign period, meet the cumulative net deposit threshold for any one of USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, or SOL, and keep Hold to Earn enabled for 10 consecutive full calendar days before the observation deadline. Users who complete all requirements and pass eligibility verification will qualify to share the 50,000 USDT prize pool.

Once any one asset meets its threshold, net deposits are calculated separately for all five assets. These net deposit amounts are then converted to USDT equivalent and added together for reward allocation. The other assets do not need to meet their individual thresholds for their net deposits to count.
Each user's reward-eligible net deposits are capped at 1,000,000 USDT equivalent. Amounts above this cap will not increase the user's reward weight.
How to Participate
Register: Click “Enroll Now” during the campaign period.
Complete the Deposit Task: Transfer supported assets from an external platform or wallet to KuCoin and meet at least one asset's cumulative net deposit threshold by the end of the campaign period.
Complete the Hold to Earn Task: Starting at 00:00 on the day after you have both registered and enabled Hold to Earn, keep the feature enabled for 10 consecutive full calendar days.
Share the Rewards: Complete all tasks and pass eligibility verification to share 50,000 USDT in proportion to your reward-eligible net deposits.
The Hold to Earn task must be completed by November 29, 2026, at 23:59 (UTC+8).
Net Deposit Calculation
Cumulative Net Deposits per Asset = Total Eligible External Deposits of That Asset During the Campaign Period − Total External Withdrawals of That Asset During the Campaign Period
Net deposits are calculated separately for USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, and SOL.
Net deposits are counted from the start of the campaign period, rather than from the time of registration.
Internal transfers, transfers between KuCoin accounts, and assets acquired through trading do not count as eligible external deposits.
Deposits and withdrawals after the campaign period do not affect campaign net deposits.
At least one asset must independently meet its threshold. Users do not qualify if no individual asset meets its threshold, even if their combined net deposits exceed 1,000 USDT equivalent.
Conversion Rules

USDT and USDC are counted at a 1:1 ratio to USDT. BTC, ETH, and SOL are converted separately using the arithmetic average of each asset's daily average platform trading prices during the campaign period.
Campaign Conversion Price per Asset = Sum of That Asset's Daily Average Platform Trading Prices During the Campaign Period ÷ Number of Calendar Days in the Campaign Period
Reward Calculation
Combined Net Deposits in USDT Equivalent
= Cumulative USDT Net Deposits + Cumulative USDC Net Deposits
+Cumulative BTC Net Deposits × Campaign BTC Conversion Price
+Cumulative ETH Net Deposits × Campaign ETH Conversion Price
+Cumulative SOL Net Deposits × Campaign SOL Conversion Price
Individual Reward-Eligible Net Deposits = min(Combined Net Deposits in USDT Equivalent, 1,000,000 USDT)
Individual Reward = 50,000 USDT × Individual Reward-Eligible Net Deposits ÷ Total Reward-Eligible Net Deposits of All Qualified Users

Only users meeting all eligibility requirements are included in the reward denominator. Each qualified user's capped reward-eligible net deposit amount is used in the calculation. All rewards are distributed in USDT.
Consecutive Activation Rules
The consecutive-day count starts at 00:00 on the day after both campaign registration and Hold to Earn activation requirements are met.
Users who already have Hold to Earn enabled must also register. Days before registration do not count.
Hold to Earn must remain enabled for 10 consecutive full calendar days. This period may extend beyond the end of the net deposit period.
Disabling Hold to Earn during a qualifying 10-day period resets the consecutive-day count.
Users may enable Hold to Earn again and restart, provided they complete 10 consecutive full calendar days by November 29, 2026, at 23:59 (UTC+8).
Users who do not complete the consecutive activation requirement are not eligible for rewards.

30-Day Average Daily Eligible Net Deposits = Sum of Daily Cumulative Eligible Net Deposit Balances During the Observation Period ÷ 30

Each daily cumulative balance equals eligible external deposits counted from the start of the campaign through that day, minus external withdrawals over the same period. The calculation averages your cumulative daily balances rather than dividing the sum of your daily deposits by 30.

blocks.x: Fellow Binancians,
As the launch of Predict (PREDICT) approaches, users who hold Predict Points (“PP Points”) may now prepare for the airdrop claim process.

PP Points are points earned by users on the Predict platform through trading, providing effective liquidity, holding positions, and early participation in markets. If you have earned PP Points, you may view them through either of the following paths:
Path 1：Binance - Assets - Prediction Account
Path 2：Binance Wallet - Discover - dApp - Predict - Assets
Actions to Take
If you are eligible for the airdrop, please submit the official form to indicate your preferred claim option. The submission deadline is 2026-11-26 09:00 (UTC).

You may choose one of the following two options. If no submission is made before the deadline, Option B will apply by default. Each user may submit the form only once, and no changes can be made after submission.
Option A: Claim Immediately

You may receive 35% of your entitled token allocation. By choosing Option A, you automatically forfeit the remaining 65% of the tokens. Once forfeited, this portion cannot be recovered from the token project.
If you choose Option A and wish to receive your tokens on the day PREDICT goes live, please submit this form before 2026-10-29 09:00 (UTC).

If you submit Option A after this time, your tokens will be included in a subsequent weekly release batch. The release dates are 2026-11-06, 2026-11-13, 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-27. The cutoff time for each batch is 09:00 (UTC) on the day before the relevant release date.
Option B: Claim After One Year of Staking
After the token project completes one year of staking, you may receive 100% of your entitled token allocation.
Token Allocation
Depending on where your PP Points are held, the tokens will be released to different accounts:
Path 1: The corresponding tokens will be credited to your Binance Alpha account.
Path 2: The corresponding tokens will be credited to your Binance Wallet.
Notice on $PREDICT Airdrop Batch Consolidation:
The five planned release dates, $PREDICT listing day, 2026-11-06, 2026-11-13, 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-27, as well as their corresponding questionnaire deadlines, will remain unchanged.

If $PREDICT goes live after any scheduled release date, that batch and any earlier unreleased batches will be merged and released in the first batch after launch. Users do not need to resubmit the questionnaire. Eligibility for each batch will still be based on the original questionnaire deadline for that batch.

blocks.x: Register during the campaign, transfer USDT or USDC into KuCoin from an external wallet or platform, and use these assets to subscribe to KCUSD, a KuCoin Earn product. Eligible users can receive 30 days of bonus APR in addition to base rewards, bringing the total APR to up to 7%. Limited to the first 3,000 eligible users. First come, first served.
30-Day Average Daily Eligible Net Deposits (USDT Equivalent)
Base APR
Bonus APR
Total Campaign APR
50,000 ≤ Net Deposit < 100,000
Net Deposit ≥ 100,000
Both tiers provide a 30-day reward period, with a maximum reward principal of 1,000,000 KCUSD per user.
The indicative total APR combines the current 4% KCUSD base APR with the applicable campaign bonus APR. The base APR is variable, and the rate displayed on the KCUSD product page prevails.
How to Participate
Complete the following steps before the campaign deadline:
Register: Click the registration button on this page to join the campaign.
Deposit: Transfer USDT or USDC into KuCoin from an external wallet or another trading platform.
Subscribe to KCUSD: Use the deposited assets to subscribe to KCUSD and hold it during your observation period to earn eligible bonus rewards.

Your individual observation period runs for 30 consecutive days from the date of your first eligible deposit during the campaign. Registration, additional deposits, and subsequent subscriptions do not restart or extend it. Users who complete these steps on the final campaign day can still complete their full individual observation period.
How Your APR Tier Is Determined

Your balance at the end of the campaign does not, by itself, determine your tier. We calculate your average daily eligible net deposits over your individual 30-day observation period to determine the applicable bonus APR.
30-Day Average Daily Eligible Net Deposits = Sum of Daily Cumulative Eligible Net Deposit Balances During the Observation Period ÷ 30

Each daily cumulative balance equals eligible external deposits counted from the start of the campaign through that day, minus external withdrawals over the same period. The calculation averages your cumulative daily balances rather than dividing the sum of your daily deposits by 30.

For example, if you deposit 100,000 USDT on the first day and make no additional deposits or withdrawals for 30 days, your daily cumulative balance and average daily eligible net deposits will both be 100,000 USDT. This qualifies for the 3% bonus APR tier.
An average below 50,000 USDT equivalent does not qualify for campaign bonus rewards.
How Your Bonus Reward Is Caculated
Eligible net deposits and KCUSD holdings are averaged separately over the same 30-day observation period.
30-Day Average Daily KCUSD Holdings = Sum of Daily KCUSD Snapshot Balances During the Observation Period ÷ 30
Your reward principal is the lowest of
Your 30-day average daily eligible net deposits;
Your 30-day average daily KCUSD holdings;
Bonus Reward = Reward Principal × Applicable Bonus APR × 30 ÷ 365

Both averages use the full 30-day period. Days without KCUSD holdings count as zero, and no separate minimum daily holding requirement applies. You may withdraw or redeem according to your funding needs, but these actions may reduce your average net deposits, average KCUSD holdings, and final reward.
Calculation Example
If your average daily eligible net deposits are 150,000 USDT and your average daily KCUSD holdings are 120,000 KCUSD, you qualify for a 3% bonus APR on a reward principal of 120,000 KCUSD.
Your estimated campaign bonus reward is: 120,000 × 3% × 30 ÷ 365 ≈ 295.89 KCUSD
This amount excludes KCUSD base rewards, which are calculated and distributed separately under the product rules. Actual campaign rewards are subject to the final calculation.
Eligible Deposits and Transfers

Only USDT and USDC transferred to KuCoin during the campaign from an external wallet, blockchain address, or another trading platform qualify as eligible external deposits, measured in USDT equivalent.

Eligible deposits and external withdrawals made during the campaign before registration are included. Registration does not reset your observation period. Deposits made after the campaign ends are excluded, while external withdrawals made before your individual observation period ends continue to be deducted.

Internal transfers do not count toward eligible net deposits. These include transfers between KuCoin accounts, between main accounts and sub-accounts, and between Funding, Trading, Earn, or other internal accounts. Subscribing to KCUSD using existing funds redeemed or released at maturity from other KuCoin Earn products does not create an eligible external deposit.
Reward Distribution

KCUSD base rewards continue to be distributed under the product rules. Campaign bonus rewards are calculated separately after your individual 30-day observation period and distributed in KCUSD in batches.

The first batch will be distributed within 10 days after registration closes to eligible users who have completed their observation periods. Users whose observation periods have not yet ended will be included in subsequent batches after completion and eligibility verification.
Holdings above the campaign reward principal may continue to earn base rewards under the product rules, but the excess does not qualify for this campaign’s bonus APR.

blocks.x: Since June, Ondo Perps has paid out over 3.5 million USDC in rewards to traders. Every week, a 175,000 USDC pool was shared based on trading activity. The more you traded, the bigger your share was.

Now, we're upgrading the USDC Rewards Program. Starting this week, from Tuesday 27 Oct 00:00 UTC to Monday 2 Nov 23:59 UTC, rewards will be increased to 220,000 USDC, and will be split across three separate pools:
Liquidity Pool: Earn by providing resting liquidity on the books of eligible markets.
Volume Pool: Earn by trading any market on Ondo Perps as a maker or taker.
Trading Activity Pool: Earn from a bonus activity that changes each week.
Each pool pays out on its own, so you can earn from one, two, or all three in the same week.
Whichever way you trade, there's now a pool for it. The more you trade, the more you can earn.
Liquidity Pool
The Liquidity Pool allows traders to earn USDC for keeping resting liquidity on the books of eligible markets. The closer your orders sit to the mid price, the bigger your share of the pool:
Resting liquidity within 25 bps of the mid price earns
85% of the pool goes to liquidity from mid to 5 bps
10% to 6–10 bps
5% to 11–25 bps
This week’s pool is split evenly across markets, with 5,000 USDC per market each week.

Snapshots of the order books are taken at random, roughly once a minute, so consistent quoting earns the most. One-sided quotes qualify, and a smaller book quoted tightly can out-earn a larger one quoted wide.
This week’s Liquidity Pool will pay out a total of 100,000 USDC to eligible traders.
This Week’s Eligible Markets
These 20 perps markets are eligible for Liquidity Pool rewards:
Stocks: NVDA, TSLA, META, AMD, INTC, MU, SNDK, COIN, MSTR, CRCL, SPCX
Indices: US 500, US 100
ETFs: DRAM, SOXL
Commodities: Gold, Silver, WTI
Crypto: BTC, ETH
The list is subject to change over time. Any changes are announced at the start of a reward week.
Volume Pool
Earn USDC simply by trading any perps market on Ondo Perps. Your share is based on your trading volume, and maker and taker volume both count.
This week, the Volume Pool will pay out a total of 100,000 USDC to eligible traders.
Trading Activity Pool
A bonus pool that rotates rewards criteria periodically. Each week's activity is announced when the week opens.
This week: trade OpenAI exposure and earn from a pool of 20,000 USDC. Trading the OpenAI Private Market Note on spot (OPAIPon) and the OpenAI perp both count toward your share.
When You Get Paid

Reward weeks run from Tuesday 00:00 UTC to Monday 23:59 UTC. Within 48 hours of each week's close, rewards are paid in USDC directly to your Ondo Perps trading account. Track your earnings and payout history on the USDC Rewards dashboard.
For a limited time only. Terms and conditions apply. Check the details:
https://www.ondoperps.xyz/legal/terms-of-use
The Ondo Points program has expanded to reward referrals, giving traders another way to earn points on Ondo Perps.

Refer traders and earn a bonus equal to 5% of the trading points they earn, with no cap on how many traders you can refer. Referral points are retroactive to the start of the points program and continue through the end of Season 1.
How It Works
When a trader you refer earns points through trading volume and open interest, you earn an additional 5% in referral points. These points are added to your total without reducing theirs.
For example, if a referred trader earns 100 trading points, you earn 5 referral points. The referred trader keeps all 100 points.
Referral Points Are Retroactive

Referral points are backdated to the start of the points program. If you’ve already brought traders to Ondo Perps through referrals, the trading points they’ve earned since the program began count toward your referral bonus. The same 5% bonus applies to both past and future trading points earned by referred traders in Season 1. The retroactive points drop today.
More Ways to Earn Ondo Points

All referral points are in addition to the fixed 5 million points distributed weekly to Perps traders in Season 1. They are posted alongside regular points in the weekly update and count toward your total on the Season 1 leaderboard.
More Details

Referral bonuses apply only to trading points earned through volume and open interest. Referral points do not generate further referral points. The referral bonus applies to points only, not USDC Rewards.
Eligibility restrictions and anti-wash checks apply. Wallets excluded from USDC Rewards cannot earn referral points. Referred traders excluded from rewards do not generate referral points.

Ondo Points are provided and managed by the Ondo Foundation, a Cayman Islands foundation company and primary shareholder of Ondo Perps. Ondo Points are not available for persons located in the US, Panama or other non-eligible jurisdictions. Additional terms and conditions apply. Participation is limited to eligible traders. For more information, see Ondo Foundation TOS.

1.Definition of Futures Bonus
The platform provides Futures Bonus subsidies according to a specified loss-offset ratio, helping reduce traders' actual trading costs.
After receiving a Futures Bonus voucher, users must activate it first. The activated bonus is then combined with the user's own funds as futures margin, increasing the margin available for positions.
2.Key Rules
01 | Activate Before Use
After claiming a Futures Bonus voucher, follow the instructions on the page to activate it. Once activation is successful, it can be used for eligible futures trades.
02 | Combined Margin
The activated Futures Bonus and the user’s own funds jointly form futures margin and can be used to cover position losses and related funding costs.
03 | Losses Offset According to a Ratio
When a loss occurs, the Futures Bonus and the user’s own funds share the loss according to the offset ratio configured by the platform.
Offset Ratio · How Losses Are Covered
100% · Losses are deducted from the Futures Bonus first. Once the bonus is depleted, the user’s own funds are deducted according to the applicable rules.
cells: Losses are deducted from the Futures Bonus first. Once the bonus is depleted, the user’s own funds are deducted according to the applicable rules.

blocks.x: 50% · 50% of the loss is deducted from the Futures Bonus, and the remaining 50% is deducted from the user's own funds.
cells: 50% of the loss is deducted from the Futures Bonus, and the remaining 50% is deducted from the user's own funds.

blocks.x: Note: The higher the offset ratio, the greater the share of losses covered by the Futures Bonus. The actual offset method is subject to the platform configuration.
04 | Trading Fees Are Deducted from Your Own Funds First
Trading fees are not deducted from the Futures Bonus and must be paid using the user's own funds. If those funds are insufficient, the platform's rules apply.
05 | Not Directly Withdrawable

The Futures Bonus principal itself cannot be withdrawn and may only be used for eligible trades under the applicable rules. Profits generated through the use of the Futures Bonus may be withdrawn in accordance with the rules.
06 | Minimum Own-Funds Requirement
The user's futures account must hold a minimum amount of their own funds to redeem and activate the Futures Bonus.
07 | Multiple Position Openings Supported

After activation, the Futures Bonus may support multiple position openings under the applicable rules. However, only one Futures Bonus with a given offset ratio may be used to open positions in the same account at any one time.
08 | Bonus Recovery and Risk Warning

When the Futures Bonus expires, the platform will recover it according to the applicable rules. Recovery may reduce the account’s available margin and could result in insufficient margin, position reduction or liquidation, or the inability to maintain open orders. Please monitor your positions and margin in a timely manner.
3.Activation and Usage Process
1.Obtain the Benefit
Obtain a Futures Bonus voucher through official campaigns, a dedicated Business Development (BD) representative, or other designated channels.
2.Check Voucher Details
Select More in the navigation bar, then go to Rewards Hub → My Vouchers to view all vouchers you have received, including voucher type, amount, validity period, offset ratio, and usage requirements.
3.Activate the Futures Bonus
The Futures Bonus must be activated first. Confirm that your futures account meets the minimum own-funds requirement; otherwise, activation will fail.
Select “Use Now” to start activation. When the prompt “Trade Now” appears, activation is complete.
4.Trade Futures
Trade within the scope specified by the benefit, and monitor margin, trading fees, funding rates, and position risk.
After activation, the voucher status changes to “Used,” and the funds are included in futures margin.
Go to Funds → Futures Account to view the Futures Bonus balance.
On the USDT-M Futures page, the available funds for opening a position will reflect the increased margin balance.
5.Check Settlement Results
Review benefit usage, trading profit and loss, and withdrawable profits according to the applicable benefit rules.
Go to Funds → Futures Orders → Transaction History to filter and view Futures Bonus fund flows.
4.Withdrawal and Restriction Rules
a. Transfers from the Futures Account
Any transfer from the futures account to another account will cause the credited Futures Bonus to be reset to zero.
b. Profits Can Be Withdrawn in Full
The Futures Bonus principal itself cannot be withdrawn or transferred, but trading profits generated from it may be withdrawn in full.
c. For Personal Use Only
The Futures Bonus cannot be gifted, sold, or monetized in any other way. Trading volume generated using the Futures Bonus is not eligible for trading-fee rebate programs.
d. Only One Voucher Can Be Activated at a Time
If multiple Futures Bonus vouchers are available in the account, redeeming a new one will invalidate the Futures Bonus currently in use in the futures account.
e. Transfers Out Are Not Permitted During Use

Any transfer of funds out of the futures account while the Futures Bonus is in use may immediately invalidate all Futures Bonus funds. Review the voucher rules and restrictions carefully before taking action.
f. Position Side
Hedge Mode is supported when opening positions with Futures Bonus, but certain actions may trigger risk controls. Platform rules apply.
g. Validity Period

Claim and use the Futures Bonus within the validity period shown on the voucher. Unused Futures Bonus will automatically expire and be reclaimed by the system. Check the expiry date and plan your positions in advance.
5.Important Information
a. Applicable Rules

The applicable scope, validity period, leverage limits, fee responsibilities, and settlement rules for Futures Bonus and other bonus benefits are subject to the specific voucher details and the platform’s latest rules.
b. Trading Risk

Futures trading involves significant risk, and leverage may magnify losses. Using Futures Bonus or other bonuses does not eliminate trading risk and does not guarantee returns or constitute investment advice.
c. Expiration and Recovery

Futures Bonus or other bonuses may expire or be reclaimed due to expiration, transfers of account funds, rule restrictions, or other specified actions. Confirm the relevant conditions before use, and manage positions and margin carefully.
d. Prevailing Terms
If this guide differs from the platform’s official rules, the platform's official rules and the specific voucher details will prevail.

When you sign up to Bitvavo with an eligible referral code, you may qualify for the Free Trading Bonus. With the bonus, the transaction fees on your trades are refunded for the first 7 days after you create your account, up to €10,000 in trading volume. The "Campaign Hub" in the Bitvavo app or on the web platform always shows your remaining days and volume.
How does the Free Trading Bonus work?
Sign up to Bitvavo using an eligible referral code. You are enrolled in the campaign automatically.
Verify your email address and complete identity verification, including bank account verification.
Make your first trades, you will pay the normal transaction fees on each trade.
The transaction fees on each qualifying trade are refunded to your Bitvavo account right after the trade, until you reach €10,000 in trading volume or the 7 days end, whichever comes first.
To see your remaining days and volume, open the "Campaign Hub" in the Bitvavo app or on the web platform. Click on the gift icon at the top of the page.
Campaign details
Period: 7 days, starting when you create your account. It does not start when you complete verification or make your first trade.
Limit: transaction fees are refunded on trades up to €10,000 in total trading volume.
Who is eligible?
To be eligible, you must:
be 18 years or older;
live in a country where the campaign is available (the "Campaign Hub" shows which countries are included);
be a new user to Bitvavo;
not have been offboarded before for compliance reasons;
create your account using a referral code that is part of the campaign;
complete identity and bank account verification.
Note: Referral codes must be entered during registration. They cannot be added later.
Which trades count?
All filled (executed) buy and sell trades within the 7 days count, until your total trading volume reaches €10,000.
Unfilled orders and trades outside the 7 days don’t count.
Only transaction fees are refunded. Transaction fees for all order types are eligible. Read more about order types.
How are the fees refunded?
The transaction fees on each qualifying trade are refunded automatically right after the trade.
Refunds are paid in euro, the same currency as the fees you paid.
You can see each refund in your transaction history.
Frequently asked questions
Can I get the Free Trading Bonus as an existing user?
No. The Free Trading Bonus is only available to new users who create their account with an eligible referral code.
Do I still pay transaction fees when I trade?
Yes. You pay the normal transaction fees on each trade. The fees on your qualifying trades are refunded right after the trade, up to €10,000 in trading volume.
What happens if I trade more than €10,000?
Trades above the limit are charged the normal transaction fees and are not refunded. If a single trade goes over the limit, only the fees on the part within the limit are refunded.
Do my trades also count toward my Welcome Bonus?
Yes. A trade can count toward a trade volume Welcome Bonus and have its transaction fees refunded under the Free Trading Bonus at the same time.
Can I create a second account to use the bonus again?
No. Creating multiple accounts is not allowed. If Bitvavo detects this, you will be disqualified and any refund received may be revoked.
I didn’t receive a refund after a trade. What should I do?
Check the "Campaign Hub" to see whether the trade falls within the 7 days and the €10,000 limit. If it does and you didn’t receive the refund, contact Bitvavo Support via support@bitvavo.com.
Terms and conditions

The Free Trading Bonus is subject to the Terms and Conditions and the Bitvavo User Agreement. Bitvavo can change or end a campaign at any time. Bitvavo may deny participation, close accounts or reclaim refunds in case of misuse, fraud or a breach of these terms.

blocks.x: What Is a Bonus?
Bonus is a type of reward distributed by the platform to users through various operational activities and promotional events.
Bonuses can be used to increase margins for position trading, or to offset a portion or all of the fees and potential losses incurred during trading.
The platform offers different types of bonuses to satisfy users' varied trading preferences. Users can obtain bonus rewards by participating in events or completing designated tasks.
Bonuses cannot be withdrawn directly. However, profits generated from trading with bonuses or bonuses that meet specified trading criteria can be withdrawn.
Perpetual Bonus Types
The Top-Up & Real-Time Deduction type is the original bonus type and retains the same functionality as the existing bonus.
The Top-Up, Top-Up & Withdrawal, and Top-Up & Expiration Deduction types are newly introduced.
Different bonus types cannot be claimed simultaneously or used together.
*Please note that when a bonus is claimed, a withdrawal restriction will be imposed on the account for the duration of the bonus validity period.

Bonus can only be used for futures trading, but profits earned from futures trading using the bonus or bonuses that meet specified trading conditions can be withdrawn.
Bonus cannot be used for asset exchange to convert into another currency, nor can it be used to pay any withdrawal gas fees.

blocks.x: Gate will upgrade its ETH staking product to improve the user experience. The upgrade is expected to finish on November 11, 2026, at 10:00 (UTC). The changes are outlined below:
1. Conversion Rate Changes
The fixed conversion rate (ETH: GTETH = 1:1) will change to a floating rate. The initial rate will remain 1:1.
The ETH-to-GTETH conversion rate will be updated once a day. Staking and redemptions are expected to pause for approximately 30 minutes during each update. A notice will appear on the product page.
2. Earnings Settlement Changes
Starting November 12, 2026, base earnings will no longer be distributed daily.
Base earnings will be settled when you redeem ETH. Your principal and earnings will be paid together, using the conversion rate at the time of redemption.
Earnings = ETH received on redemption − staked principal
Additional rewards are unaffected and will continue to be distributed daily under the existing rules.
3. Expanded GTETH Features
After the upgrade, GTETH deposits, withdrawals, and transfers will be enabled gradually. Check future announcements or the product page for availability dates.

During the upgrade, new ETH staking subscriptions are expected to pause for approximately 30 minutes. Redemptions will remain available. After the upgrade, staking and redemptions will pause briefly during each daily conversion rate update.
